decisions.reason: As a visible 2023 launch that extends the established dumper range and is still given its own page in 2024, it fits the core business well enough that prior investment and public commitment favor continuation.

This articulated dumper remains prominently marketed and sits inside the firm's established construction equipment logic, so management is likely to justify staying the course despite limited disclosed results.

Because the mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core offer and slipped from a dedicated page to only a mention, the case for continued escalation is weaker and withdrawal becomes more likely.
A multi-model telescopic loader line represents a larger visible commitment in a core adjacent category, making management especially likely to persist and defend the launch.
The material lift line is close to the established offer and is backed by a reported major order and long-standing rental success, so there is little reason for management to reverse course.
Although more distant from the traditional range, the underground loader has a dedicated page and strong early utilization evidence, which supports continued commitment rather than an early exit.
